Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:6615 Court No. - 88 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 29268 of 2023 Applicant :- Hariram And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Pandey,Devi Prasad Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Pachori,J.
Sri Manish Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Umesh Chandra Verma,
learned A.G.A. for the State are present.

The present application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed to quash the entire criminal proceedings of Complaint Case No. 6618 of 2014 (Smt. Archana vs. Sudhir Kumar and others), as well as order dated 16.12.2022 by which non-bailable warrant has been issued against the applicant by Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C. Jhansi, under Sections 326,

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant fairly admits that the stay extension application is pending in the application u/s 482 no. 30979 of 2015.
By way of this present application, prayer is against Non-bailable warrant only.

In view of aforesaid, the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed due to filing of earlier application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
Office is directed to show connected file in the next cause list.
